visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Move a table caption into caption
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The title of this table is a paragraph above it. Use a caption element inside the table, so the title belongs to the table. The numbers must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A caption is part of the table, so screen readers announce it when the table is reached and it moves with the table. A separate paragraph is only close to the table by position.

checks.label: The title Weekly steps is on the page
